result.topic_en: Formulas for the altitude p from C to AB of a plane triangle and of a spherical triangle given sides a, b and the included angle C, followed by a formula for a product c'c''c'''...c^{(n)} expressed as a sum of 2^n terms.
result.transcription:
Math 22
Problemata Trigonometrica
46 b/12
(12)
I Datis $AC = b$
$BC = a$
$p = \sqrt{\frac{aabb \sin C^2}{aa - 2ab\cos C + bb}}$
II Manentibus denominationibus erit in triangulo sphaerico
$\sin p^2 = \frac{\sin a^2 \sin b^2 \sin C^2}{1 - \cos b^2 \cos c^2 - 2\cos C \cos b \sin b \cos c \sin c - \cos C^2 \sin b^2 \sin c^2}$
55 #
$c'c''c'''\ldots c^N = \frac{1}{2^n}\big((c.1.2.3\ldots n) + (c\,1.2.3 - n) + c.1.2.3 - n-1. - n)\ldots\big)$
seu elegantius hoc modo
$\frac{1}{2^n} c..(n) + ((n-1)-(1)) + ((n-2)-(2)) + \&c.$
Termini $2^n$.
